Contributing — Sample
=====================

:Status: Maintained
:Date: 2026-01-01

Branches
--------

Work starts from ``main`` on a branch named ``feat/<topic>`` or ``fix/<topic>``.

Commits
-------

Conventional Commits, unsigned; one change per commit.

Pull requests
-------------

The body states what changed and how it was verified.

Verification
------------

``make check`` passes.

Records
-------

:Amends: none

A record names an older record it replaces in ``Supersedes``, wholly or
``in part``; no record amends another.
